Fifty lakh home loan for twenty years? You'll pay about fifty lakh more, just in interest. Here's how to cut it.
At eight percent, the EMI is forty one thousand eight hundred. Total interest, fifty point four lakh. More than the loan itself.
Trick one. Pay one extra EMI every year. Save nine lakh, and finish three years early.
Trick two. Prepay one lakh every year. Save seventeen lakh. Done in fourteen years.
Trick three, the best. Raise your EMI by five percent every year, as your salary grows. Save seventeen point seven lakh. Done in about twelve years.
Trick four. Ask your bank for a lower rate. Just half a percent less saves three point seven lakh.
And every time you prepay, tell the bank. Reduce my tenure, not my EMI.
Before you prepay, keep six months of expenses as an emergency fund. Floating rate home loans usually have no prepayment charge, but check with your bank.
